milestones.title: Publish the society’s first website
milestones.description: Publish membership information, leadership openings, the first-year roadmap, and links to Oberlin and partner-school resources.

milestones.title: Recruit the founding group
milestones.description: Collect interest forms, confirm the remaining founding members, and fill the open officer roles.

milestones.title: Hold the first member meeting
milestones.description: Meet with founding members to review officer roles, project interests, chartering work, and immediate tasks.

milestones.title: Review proposals for the first projects
milestones.description: Confirm a lead, workspace, tools, estimated cost, safety needs, and first milestone before selecting a project.

milestones.title: Hold the first confirmed event
milestones.description: Set an organizer, topic, date, room, and access information before announcing the event.

milestones.title: Publish a short founding-term report
milestones.description: Report confirmed participation counts, meetings held, project status, spending, unfinished work, and next steps.
